name: mlflow
description: The MLflow provider for Pulumi manages MLflow experiments, model registry entries, and access-control resources through the MLflow REST API. It supports MLflow tracking servers 2.x and 3.x.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to the tracking server. Not recommended in production.

token.description: Bearer token for authenticating against the MLflow tracking server. Takes precedence over username/password.

trackingUri.description: URL of the MLflow tracking server, e.g. https://mlflow.example.com. May also be set via the MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI environment variable.

username.description: Username for HTTP Basic authentication against the MLflow tracking server.

artifactLocation.description: Root artifact storage location for the experiment (e.g. an `s3://` URI). Optional — the server assigns a default when omitted. **Immutable:** set once at creation; changing it forces the experiment to be replaced.

artifactUri.description: Resolved artifact storage location as reported by the tracking server.

experimentId.description: Server-assigned unique identifier of the experiment.

lifecycleStage.description: Lifecycle stage of the experiment: "active" or "deleted".

name.description: Human-readable, unique name of the experiment. Must be unique across active experiments on the tracking server; updating it renames the experiment in place.

tags.description: Key/value tags attached to the experiment. Updated in place via `set-experiment-tag`. **Note:** MLflow has no delete-experiment-tag endpoint, so removing a tag in place is not supported.
